# iosxe_interface_hsrp (Data Source)

This data source can read the Interface HSRP configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_interface_hsrp" "example" {
  type = "Vlan"
  name = "123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) Interface type

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `bfd` (Boolean) Enable HSRP BFD
- `delay_minimum` (Number) HSRP initialisation minimum delay
- `delay_reload` (Number) HSRP initialisation delay after reload
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `mac_refresh` (Number) Refresh MAC cache on switch by periodically sending packet from virtual mac address
- `redirect_timers_advertisement` (Number) Redirect advertisement timer in seconds
- `redirect_timers_holddown` (Number) Redirect holddown timer in seconds
- `redirect_unknown` (Boolean) Redirect to non-HSRP routers
- `standby_list` (Attributes List) HSRP group configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--standby_list))
- `use_bia` (Boolean) HSRP uses interface's burned in address
- `use_bia_scope_interface` (Boolean) Use-bia applies to all groups on this interface or sub-interface
- `version` (String) HSRP version

<a id="nestedatt--standby_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `standby_list`

Read-Only:

- `authentication_text` (String, Sensitive) Plain text authentication string
- `authentication_word` (String, Sensitive) Authentication word (plain text)
- `follow` (String) Name of HSRP group to follow
- `group_number` (Number) HSRP group number
- `ip` (Boolean) Enable HSRP and set the virtual IP address
- `ip_address` (String) Virtual IPv4 address
- `ip_secondary_addresses` (Attributes List) Secondary virtual IPv4 addresses (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--standby_list--ip_secondary_addresses))
- `ipv6_addresses` (Attributes List) IPv6 global unicast prefix addresses (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--standby_list--ipv6_addresses))
- `ipv6_link_local` (String) IPv6 link-local address or autoconfig
- `mac_address` (String) Virtual MAC address
- `name` (String) Redundancy name string
- `preempt` (Boolean) Overthrow lower priority Active routers
- `preempt_delay_minimum` (Number) Minimum preempt delay in seconds
- `preempt_delay_reload` (Number) Preempt delay after reload in seconds
- `preempt_delay_sync` (Number) Wait for IP redundancy client sync delay in seconds
- `priority` (Number) Priority level
- `timers_hello_interval_msec` (Number) Hello interval in milliseconds
- `timers_hello_interval_seconds` (Number) Hello interval in seconds
- `timers_hold_time_msec` (Number) Hold time in milliseconds
- `timers_hold_time_seconds` (Number) Hold time in seconds
- `tracks` (Attributes List) Priority tracking (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--standby_list--tracks))

<a id="nestedatt--standby_list--ip_secondary_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `standby_list.ip_secondary_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `secondary` (Boolean) Make this IP address a secondary virtual IP address

Read-Only:

- `prefix` (String)
